description: Statically audits an MCP tool definitions JSON array (toolDefinitionsJson, max 100,000 chars; accepts standard tools/list entries) for snake_case naming, schema completeness, deceptive ToolAnnotations, privilege scope, duplicate names, and injection surfaces. Free, deterministic, stateless check with no API key required; set strictMode=true to penalize missing parameter descriptions or annotations (returns FAIL on malformed JSON). Use for MCP JSON schema inspection; do NOT use for system prompts — call systemores_tool_integrity instead.

strictMode.description: When true, applies stricter scoring thresholds — missing optional fields such as parameter descriptions, inputSchema, and MCP tool annotations are penalized. Defaults to false.

toolDefinitionsJson.description: A JSON-serialized array of tool definition objects to audit. Each object should contain at minimum 'name' and 'description' fields. Accepts standard MCP ListToolsResult format.

name: systemores_audit_tool_integrity
title: Audit MCP Tool Definitions Integrity
